description:
intent=i039 snapshot=s10 branch=net-epidx status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/usb/r8152.c:1352-1361 confidence=high conclusion=r8152 alloc_all_mem reads alt->endpoint + 2 .desc.bInterval (r8152.c:1357,1433) to program the interrupt URB interval with no bNumEndpoints >= 3 check anywhere in the driver; a gadget matching the Realtek/Lenovo/NVIDIA IDs with <= 2 endpoints makes ep_intr out of bounds at ifup (OOB read, OOB-sou.
finding location=drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c:3582-3592 confidence=high conclusion=lan78xx_probe dereferences cur_altsetting->endpoint + 0/+1/+2 (lan78xx.c:3582-3592) to program pipe_intr, the kmalloc(maxp) interrupt buffer and URB period with no bNumEndpoints >= 3 check and with bind ignoring lan78xx_get_endpoints' return; a 0-2-endpoint gadget spoofing the Microchip LAN78xx I.
finding location=drivers/net/usb/qmi_wwan.c:291-318 confidence=medium conclusion=qmi_wwan_bind's subdriver setup reads control-interface endpoint[0] with no bNumEndpoints check (qmi_wwan.c:304) and passes &dev->status->desc to usb_cdc_wdm_register (316); a gadget with a zero-endpoint COMM control interface and union-pointed data interface NULL-derefs at probe.
finding location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/hif_usb.c:1213-1230 confidence=high conclusion=ath9k_hif_usb send_eject_command reads altsetting[0].endpoint[1] then [0] with no bNumEndpoints check (hif_usb.c:1223-1224) directly from probe for the storage ID 0cf3:20ff; a 0-1-endpoint gadget crashes probe or feeds an OOB-read address into the eject bulk pipe.
finding location=drivers/net/wireless/zydas/zd1211rw/zd_usb.c:1272-1290 confidence=high conclusion=zd1211rw eject_installer reads altsetting[0].endpoint[1] then [0] with no bNumEndpoints check (zd_usb.c:1282-1283) directly from probe for installer IDs 0ace:2011/0ace:20ff; a 0-1-endpoint gadget crashes probe on plug-in or uses an OOB-read address for the eject pipe.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/wwan does not exist in snapshot s10 (no such directory), so wwan USB NIC paths could not be checked in this tree; only drivers/net/usb and drivers/net/wireless were in scope of the actual search.
coverage_gap=cdc_mbim.c and huawei_cdc_ncm.c were spot-checked only for status-endpoint consumption; their full control-interface handling beyond the cdc_ncm bounded path was not read end to end.
